title: 第572章 突然激动第571章 不法之徒
content_zh:
当天晚上还是很安静的，伊妮丝没有真的像个婊子一样，带领城防卫队士兵去抓艾什，艾什美美地享受了一夜好梦。
第二天一早，等到大家都起床准备做自己的事，艾什把昨天的遭遇告诉了大家，巴尼骂艾什做事太鲁莽了，想要情报选择配合不好吗？非要揍伊妮丝一顿，这是在赌博！
艾什却不以为意，伊妮丝用那种厌恶的眼神看她，以艾什的性格，怎么可能以平和的心态和她说话？巴尼也就只能无语摇头，说大家还是先不要去买东西或者散开，就先在旅馆等伊妮丝的到来。
他的想法是万一伊妮丝反悔，从昨夜开始就暗中观察艾什几人，那么大家散开的话，很有可能被城防卫队逐个逮捕，大家在一起还是能互相照料的。
嘴上埋怨艾什做事动脑子但又不细致想想的巴尼，心里还是理解艾什的，和这个疯女人相处了这么久，巴尼可是深知艾什不算蠢笨，就是过于活的随性了，即使自己在场，艾什也会这么做，他改变不了什么。
其余人也没什么意见，高精灵也好，森林精灵也好，不获得更多消息就离开洛瑞安，迟早会有大麻烦，城里有伊妮丝的城防卫队，城外有夜纱低语会的暗精灵，怎么样都要和他们有交集的。
伊妮丝要找艾什肯定是想知道更多关于夜纱低语会的细节，给她想要的，大家就应该不会再被她“骚扰”
其实就算伊妮丝不找艾什，昨晚不拦住她，未来夜纱低语会的暗精灵被捕更多，伊妮丝得知夜纱低语会在找寻大家，城防卫队也迟早会开始调查众人的。
夜纱低语会的暗精灵既然能知道艾什几人的外貌，他们肯定也在找几人，报复？有很大的可能喔。
巴尼提出还是由他和伊妮丝聊一聊吧，以艾什的性格，说不准没说三句话就开始讽刺伊妮丝，说不准还会扩散到整个种族呢，为了不把事态扩大，巴尼要艾什闭嘴。
艾什可没觉得自己做错什么，她大大咧咧的往早餐的南瓜猪肉汤里撒胡椒粉，无所谓地撇撇嘴，对她来说，伊妮丝和夜纱低语会都不是问题。
最大的问题是她还是吃不习惯精灵的食物，油和盐都少，还要自己调和味道，那干嘛不自己做饭？！
看艾什完全不把这件事放在心上的样子，巴尼抬手就去打艾什后脑，但是手都举起来了，转念一想自己等下会被揍得更惨，摇摇头还是算了。
早饭都没吃完，伊妮丝就早早的来到了绿木树根旅馆，她一进门就看到艾什和一群人坐在一起，顿时感觉自己又被艾什戏耍了。
不过这次她没有生气，倒是摆摆手，和艾什打招呼，艾什抬起脚把身边的巴尼踹开，巴尼呲着牙，走上前和伊妮丝介绍起了自己，可对方直接绕过巴尼，完全不听巴尼的话，径直来到艾什身边坐下。
因为早餐的味道而不满意的艾什单手拄着下巴，眼珠随着伊妮丝的走来而转动，芙涅娅对巴尼眨眨眼，桌上的大家纷纷站起，换到其他桌子去做，把烂事甩给了艾什，只留下捧着面包吃得开心的嘶嘶。
“早安。”
伊妮丝主动问好，并把视线从巴尼几人身上扫过，艾什搅拌起汤汁，稍微尝了一口，吐了吐舌头，对胡椒味儿的南瓜块直呲牙，她顺手推过去精灵沙拉，放下木勺耸肩。
“你来的很早哦。”
“是的，因为，我更想知道你，或者说你们，和夜纱低语会的事，坐在一边的那些旅者，可不像是你说的那样，你‘自己’住在绿木树根旅馆。”

虽说伊妮丝对艾什再一次戏耍她没有生气，但是多少还有些不满的，艾什厚着脸皮笑笑，指着巴尼的背影，用木勺去戳碎南瓜块。
“因为我对你们精灵很不信任，如果你想知道更多事，你可以问那个吟游诗人，他比我更会措辞。”
伊妮丝顺着艾什的手看了看巴尼，又把目光落在往汤中撕面包的伊拉身上，她勉强附和艾什笑了下，收回视线坐到艾什对面。
“那位森林精灵小姐不应该也是你的同伴吗？”
“她不一样，她是个傻子。”
艾什如实回答，伊拉根本没在听两人说什么，还在摇头晃脑的享受同族的食物，这下轮到伊妮丝不知道该怎么回答了，就像是习惯一样，握拳在嘴前干咳两声，并不打算再多说些无用的，直奔主题。
“弗洛斯特小姐，你说你杀了夜纱低语会的暗精灵，这件事，我希望你能准确的告诉我，是在哪和他们战斗的？”
彻底放弃这碗即使调味也救不回来了的南瓜炖肉汤，艾什伸手去拿夹了肉馅的烤肉饼，放在嘴里咬了口品尝味道，觉得还不错地耸肩，不急不慢的回答。
“在你们和矮人的边境，矮人境内，条约区？至少木牌上是这么写的，哟，卡森，我们杀了几个暗精灵？”
隔着伊妮丝去喊卡森，卡森本和芙涅娅在聊画具的事，听到艾什叫他，他也不是很确定了，侧头与泽瑞尔回想那晚的事，稍有些不把握的说：
“差不多十几个，或许更多，天太黑，忙着救巴尼，我杀了三个，泽瑞尔杀了大概五个，你呢？”
“唔......六个？我记不清了。”
伊妮丝有些震惊于艾什几人平淡地爆出数字，她咬了咬下唇，严肃起态度，回头又看了一遍艾什的同伴们。
人类骑士，牧师和个吟游诗人，法杖就在桌边的......法师？森林精灵和矮人的关系看起来还不错，再转回来，还有个摇着蛇尾的拉米亚女孩。
几个人杀死了十几个暗精灵？伊妮丝有些怀疑，然而昨晚艾什轻松的战胜她，又加深了她心中的疑虑，她再次干咳，接着问道：
“那么，弗洛斯特小姐，你们从矮人边境抵达洛瑞安，用了几天时间？”
“具体记不清了，不到一周，怎么了？”
content_en:
It was still very quiet that night. Inis didn't really act like a bitch and led the city defense soldiers to catch Ash. Ash enjoyed a good night's sleep.
Early the next morning, when everyone got up and got ready to do their own thing, Ash told everyone what happened yesterday. Barney scolded Ash for being too reckless. If he wanted information, wouldn't he choose to cooperate? If you insist on beating Inis, this is gambling!
Ash didn't take it seriously. Inis looked at her with such disgust. With Ash's character, how could he talk to her in a peaceful manner? Barney could only shake his head speechlessly and said that everyone should not go shopping or disperse, but wait for Inis' arrival in the hotel.
His idea was that if Inis went back on her word and secretly observed Ash and the others since last night, then if everyone dispersed, they would most likely be arrested one by one by the city defense team, and everyone could still take care of each other when they were together.
Barney, who complained that Ash was using his brains when doing things but didn't think carefully about it, understood Ash in his heart. After getting along with this crazy woman for so long, Barney knew that Ash was not stupid, but just too casual. Ash would do this even if he was there, and he couldn't change anything.
The rest of the people didn't have any objections. Whether it was high elves or forest elves, if they left Lorien without getting more information, they would be in big trouble sooner or later. There were Inis's city defense team in the city, and there were dark elves from the Nightshade Whispering Society outside the city. They would have to interact with them no matter what.
Inis must be looking for Ash because she wants to know more details about the Nightshade Whispering Club. If you give her what she wants, everyone will no longer be "harassed" by her.
In fact, even if Inis doesn't look for Ash and doesn't stop her last night, more dark elves from the Nightshade Whisper Club will be arrested in the future. If Inis learns that the Nightshade Whisper Club is looking for everyone, the city defense team will start investigating everyone sooner or later.
Since the dark elves in the Yesha Whispering Club can know the appearance of Ash and others, they must be looking for revenge on a few of them too? It's very possible.
Barney suggested that he and Inis should have a chat. With Ash's character, he might start mocking Inis in less than three sentences, and it might spread to the entire race. In order not to escalate the situation, Barney asked Ash to shut up.
Ash didn't think she had done anything wrong. She carelessly sprinkled pepper into the pumpkin and pork soup for breakfast and curled her lips indifferently. For her, Inis and Yesha's whispering session was not a problem.
The biggest problem is that she is still not used to eating elf food, which has less oil and salt, and she has to adjust the taste herself, so why not cook it herself? !
Seeing that Ash didn't take this matter to heart at all, Barney raised his hand to hit Ash on the back of the head, but his hand was raised. Then he thought that he would be beaten worse later, so he shook his head and let it go.
Even before finishing breakfast, Inis arrived at the Greenwood Roots Hotel early. As soon as she entered the door, she saw Ash sitting with a group of people, and she immediately felt that she was being played by Ash again.
But this time she wasn't angry. Instead, she waved her hand and greeted Ash. Ash raised his foot and kicked Barney away from him. Barney bared his teeth and stepped forward to introduce himself to Inis, but the other party walked around Barney and didn't listen to Barney at all. He went straight to sit next to Ash.
Ash, who was dissatisfied with the taste of breakfast, held his chin with one hand and moved his eyes as Inis walked over. Funea winked at Barney. Everyone at the table stood up and moved to other tables, leaving the bad thing to Ash, leaving only hissing happily while holding the bread.
"Good morning."
Inis took the initiative to say hello and glanced at Barney and the others. Ash stirred the soup, took a small taste, stuck out his tongue, and bared his teeth at the peppery pumpkin pieces. She pushed the elf salad over and put down the wooden spoon and shrugged.
"You came very early."
"Yes, because, I want to know more about you, orWhat you and Ye Sha whispered about the meeting, those travelers sitting aside, are not like you said, you 'yourself' live in the Green Tree Roots Hotel. "
Although Inis was not angry at Ash teasing her again, she was still somewhat dissatisfied. Ash smiled cheekily, pointed at Barney's back, and used a wooden spoon to poke the pumpkin pieces.
"Because I don't trust you elves very much. If you want to know more, you can ask the bard. He knows the words better than me. "
Inis followed Ash's hand and looked at Barney, then her eyes fell on Ila who was tearing bread into the soup. She reluctantly agreed with Ash and smiled, then withdrew her gaze and sat across from Ash.
"Shouldn't that forest elf lady also be your companion? "
“She’s different, she’s a fool. "
Ash answered truthfully. Ila didn't listen to what the two said at all, and was still shaking her head while enjoying the food of her own race. Now it was Inis's turn and she didn't know how to answer. As if it was a habit, she made a fist in front of her mouth and coughed twice. She didn't intend to say any more useless words and went straight to the topic.
"Miss Frost, you said you killed the dark elves from the Yesha Whispering Society. I hope you can tell me exactly where you fought them? "
Completely giving up on this bowl of pumpkin stew that even seasoning couldn't save, Ash reached out for the meat-stuffed barbecue patty, put it in his mouth and took a bite to taste the taste. He thought it was pretty good and shrugged, and answered unhurriedly.
“On the border between you and the dwarves, within the dwarf territory, in the treaty area? At least that's what the wooden sign says, Yo, Carson, how many dark elves did we kill? "
He went to call Carson through Inis. Carson and Funea were talking about painting supplies. When he heard Ash calling him, he was not sure. He turned his head and recalled what happened that night with Zerrell, and said with a little uncertainty:
"Almost a dozen, maybe more. It was too dark and we were busy saving Barney. I killed three, and Zariel killed about five. What about you?" "
“Hmm…six? I can't remember clearly. "
Inis was a little shocked when Ash and the others revealed the numbers calmly. She bit her lower lip, became serious, and looked back at Ash's companions again.
A human knight, a priest and a bard, and the one with the staff at the table...the mage? The relationship between the forest elves and the dwarves seems to be pretty good, and back again, there is a Lamian girl wagging a snake tail.
How many people killed a dozen dark elves? Inis was a little skeptical, but Ash's easy victory over her last night only deepened her doubts. She coughed again, and then asked:
"So, Miss Frost, how many days did it take for you to arrive at Lorien from the dwarf border? "
“I can’t remember exactly, it was less than a week, what happened? "
